scope: Read-only initial-blue candidate foot math; no production edit, GUI, engine or real action. Parent 886 outer-outline samples preserved.

registration.scope: UNSELECTED new-design registration. Original visible doorstep intersects actual legal walk shoe segments. No gameplay. Hidden floor not certified.
registration.stoneFootMeaning: Opaque measured last pixels within visually identified stone-base x150..1035; each slice owns deepest sample in its interval; roof edges extrapolated.

alphaAndMaterialObservation.meaning: The registered corner is opaque dark outline, not a white stone interior. This is a valid positional anchor but should not be described as an independently certified original physical point. The bottom stone face was manually inspected in the two grid crops.
alphaAndMaterialObservation.supplementalColorTraceRule: Only manually inspected base x150..1035,y>=940. Last pixel A>=200 and RGB mean>=45, to distinguish opaque black outline from stone. Supplemental trace is not substituted for the frozen outer silhouette and is not a universal physical-foot detector.

hypotheticalHiddenRearClosure.formula: hidden = left + right - front; conventional parallelogram direction only. Original blue rear floor not exposed.
hypotheticalHiddenRearClosure.limitation: Separation from the orange visible front line does not certify its hidden rear volume or original neighbour foundation. No arbitrary whole-building bbox used.

limits: Only real frozen Torren walk front-support boot contours; not full shoes or other roles.
Nonblocked texel assignment alone is not a navigation defect.
New hidden closure is a possible explicit design, not recovered source geometry.
North shifts are diagnostic proposals, not changed registration or approved rendering.
